title: feat(i18n): a flow screen with its own heading gets a translatable step name
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9App7SwcDfGUokz2R18dPK7)_
Fixes #36530
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ19xzW4F83HZd4Up6
Clause-②: yes (widening: `objectstack validate` accepts `flows.FLOW.nodes.NODE_ID.label` over a screen that authors a non-empty `config.title`; `@objectstack/spec/automation` gains `flowDecisionEdgeBranch`, `FlowDecisionEdgeBranch`, `FLOW_DECISION_DEFAULT_BRANCH_LABEL`)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #36401

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:译文语言下的流程说明书和流程设计器里,自带标题的界面步骤现在显示译名;标题里带占位符的步骤不再显示原文或未填充的模板。
- 为什么做:补齐流程步骤名翻译这项工作的最后一块,让每个画出来的步骤都有译名位置。
- 出错会怎样:最坏情况是某个界面步骤仍显示原文名称,不影响流程运行;改动只涉及显示和校验,可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

Ruling 7076440876 (on #35979) says every drawn step can carry a label per language. A screen that sets its own `config.title` was the one gap: its heading had a key (`screens.NODE_ID.title`) but its canvas label had none, because `objectstack validate` refused `nodes.NODE_ID.label` over any screen. The key name, `flows.FLOW.nodes.NODE_ID.label`, is the seat's call in claim 7086969804. `screens.NODE_ID.label` was not used because `screens` already aliases `label` onto `title`.

- **Validator** (`packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts`): `ScreenFacts.titled` records whether a screen has a non-empty string `config.title`. A `nodes` key over a titled screen is accepted. Over an untitled screen it is still refused (`TRANSLATION_TARGET_UNKNOWN`) and pointed at `screens.NODE_ID.title`, and the message now says why. Over an approval it is still pointed at `approvals.NODE_ID.label`. Did-you-mean suggestions now include titled screens.
- **Reader** (`ui/packages/i18n/src/flowLabels.ts`): `stepLabel` returns `nodes.NODE_ID.label` for a titled screen. For an untitled screen, a translated `screens.NODE_ID.title` that holds a `{{` hole now returns `undefined`, so the drawing falls back to the authored label (card item 2).
- **Docs embed** (`metadata-viewer.tsx` `flowStepName`): the heading test now runs before `stepLabel`. A titled screen is still named by its translated heading when that heading has no hole. Only a holed heading falls to the `nodes` key, then to the authored label.
- **Studio canvas**: no code change. `FlowCanvas` already draws `stepLabel(node) ?? node.label`, so it now draws a titled screen's `nodes` translation.
- **Walk** (`packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts`): asks for `nodes.NODE_ID.label` on a top-level screen whose authored `config.title` holds `{{`. That is where the docs embed draws the label. The rule, and why the Studio canvas read does not widen it, is under Acceptance notes.
- **One branch rule** (comment 7084469163): `flowDecisionEdgeBranch(edge, conditions)` and `FLOW_DECISION_DEFAULT_BRANCH_LABEL` now live in `packages/spec/src/automation/flow-altitude.ts` beside `FLOW_TECHNICAL_NODE_TYPES`. `decisionBranches` (`flow-branches.ts`) and `decisionBranchTechnicalTargets` (`i18n-walk.ts`) both call it. Both local `'default'` constants are deleted. It is a pure function over plain records, so no UI guard types move into spec.
- **Spec prose**: the `nodes` group docblock, the comment and the two `.describe` strings in `translation.zod.ts` now describe the titled-screen case. There is no shape change: the group is still a plain `z.record`. `content/docs/references/system/translation.mdx`, `api-surface/automation.json` and `export-origins/automation.json` were regenerated with `check:generated --fix`. The `liveness/translation.json` evidence and notes were updated; no cited symbol moved.

## Tests

- Validator: accepts `nodes` over a titled screen next to its `screens` heading key. Still refuses it over an untitled screen (rule, severity, path, plus the redirect key) and over an approval. Offers a titled screen as did-you-mean.
- Embed (`metadata-viewer.test.tsx`): a holed-title screen is named by its `nodes` key and never by its heading. A plain-title screen keeps its heading even when a `nodes` key exists. An untitled screen whose translated title adds a hole is named by its authored label.
- Studio (`FlowCanvas.test.tsx`): the canvas draws a titled screen's `nodes` translation, and an untitled screen whose translation adds a hole keeps its authored label. The `stepLabel` unit assertion for a titled screen moves from `undefined` to the `nodes` value.
- Walk (`packages/cli/test/i18n-flow-node-coverage.test.ts`): asks for the key on a top-level holed-title screen. Does not ask on a plain-title screen, an untitled screen or a nested holed-title screen.

<details><summary>Local runs (tree 6f3b8c88)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: Test Files 225 passed (225), Tests 9446 passed. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 875 passed (875), Tests 27972 passed, 1 todo.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit`: Test Files 436 passed (436), Tests 6208 passed. The integration layer is left to CI: the diff touches no integration file and no spawn entry.
- UI: `vitest run` over metadata-viewer, the basic renderer tests, FlowCanvas and `packages/i18n/`: Test Files 133 passed, Tests 2355 passed, 13 skipped. `type-check` for `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/app-shell`: all three Done, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: 3 stale (api-surface, export-origins, docs), fixed with `--fix`; the re-check after the write is green.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (one per behaviour the tests pin; every mutation landed, every restore verified as blob == HEAD)</summary>

- Validator: deleted the `titled` skip. Red: 1 failed (the accept test).
- `stepLabel` hole test: replaced with a bare `return title`. Red: 2 failed (the embed test and the canvas test for an untitled screen with a hole).
- `stepLabel` titled screen: returned `undefined` for every screen. Red: 3 failed (the embed holed-title test, the `stepLabel` unit test and the canvas test).
- `flowStepName` order: put `stepLabel` back before the heading. Red: 1 failed ("never by its heading").
- Walk: always skipped screens. Red: 1 failed (the cli walk test). The mutated lint build failed its DTS step (TS6133 on the now-unused `title`), and the dist preflight showed the marker absent. So the red came through the cli suite's source resolution of the walk, not through `dist`. Restore: lint rebuilt, `--absent` preflight exit 0.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Walk rule chosen (A4).** The walk asks for `nodes.NODE_ID.label` on a **top-level** screen whose **authored** `config.title` is a string holding `{{`. That is exactly where the docs embed draws the label at `detail: business`. The Studio canvas draws the label for every titled screen, but the walk already asks only for what the docs embed draws. It does not ask for the technical steps the canvas also draws either, so the canvas read does not widen the demand. The validator accepts the key over **every** titled screen, at any depth, because the canvas reads it there.
- **Coverage baseline**: unchanged. A static read of every `type: 'screen'` node in `examples/`, `packages/platform-objects` and `packages/plugins` finds 14 screens and no `config.title` holding `{{`, so each config moves by +0. The local `check:i18n-coverage` run was NOT MEASURED (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: the example closure is not built); CI runs it.
- **`FLOW_DECISION_DEFAULT_BRANCH_LABEL`** has the same word as the engine's `DEFAULT_BRANCH_LABEL` (`service-automation` `engine.ts`). The engine keeps its own constant: switching it to the spec export is outside this card's file surface.
- Not merged with `origin/main` before opening. `overlap-check.mjs` was run before each push and was clean against main and against #36574, which shares six of these files and merges cleanly.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/basic/metadata-viewer.tsx` `flowStepName`: the reorder. A plain heading must still win over a `nodes` key.
2. `packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts`, the `nodes` block: the `titled` skip and its fact in `collectFlowRecord`.
3. `packages/spec/src/automation/flow-altitude.ts` `flowDecisionEdgeBranch`: it must match the two readers it replaced.

Two-minute check: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/src/__tests__/metadata-viewer.test.tsx -t "titled screen"`. Expect `Tests  4 passed | 20 skipped`, including "names a titled screen whose heading holds a hole by its nodes key, and never by its heading".

Out of scope, kept as notes: the ADR wording for the key goes to #36086, and the skill text for the key to #36401.
